description: This PHP file defines a class 'Information' within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. The class contains methods to handle event-driven tasks such as adding, editing, and deleting information entries by scheduling corresponding tasks.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: A controller class to manage event-related tasks for information data in the Opencart admin panel, handling the scheduling of background tasks upon information CRUD operations.

methods.name: addInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to add a new information record and its associated detail.

methods.name: editInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update an existing information record and its details.

methods.name: deleteInformation
methods.description: Schedules tasks to delete an information record and its associated data.
